title: CVE-2025-64393: Critical Veeam Backup & Replication RCE Vulnerability
content_md: Veeam has released a security update addressing CVE-2025-64393, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Veeam Backup & Replication. The flaw has received a CVSS 4.0 score of 9.4 and enables a low-privileged authenticated user with the Backup Viewer role to execute arbitrary code on the Veeam Backup Server. The vulnerability stems from insecure deserialization of untrusted data processed through the Mount Service. Given the sensitive role backup infrastructure plays in enterprise environments, successful exploitation could provide attackers with a powerful foothold for accessing recovery infrastructure, credentials, and other critical resources. The issue was addressed on October 6, 2026, with the release of Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4, build 12.3.2.4934. All version 12 builds up to and including 12.3.2.4854 are affected, while Veeam Backup & Replication version 13 is not vulnerable.
